question: Will the Banco Central del Paraguay announce a payment start date for ueno bank CDA holders by 28 November 2026?

calls.reasoning: La Nación (13 Nov 2026) reports the BCP announced CDA payments to ueno holders would begin 'este viernes' (Friday 13 Nov), released in batches as ownership checks cleared. La Nación's 14 Nov print edition reports the BCP released CDA funds 'desde ayer', and on 17 Nov the BCP said banks were continuing CDA payments. A BCP statement naming the start day therefore appears to exist already. The main risk is the resolver: the question's background says no date had been announced as of 13 Nov, and 'this Friday' might be judged not to be a specific calendar day. No human market found on Polymarket, Manifold, Kalshi or bookmakers.

- La Nación 13 Nov 2026, 'El BCP anuncia la liberación de fondos de los CDA desde este viernes': reports the BCP announced CDA payments for ueno customers would start 'this Friday', with funds released in batches during the day as ownership checks finished, via the BCP web platform. The fetched text says 'Friday, November 15', but 15 Nov 2026 is a Sunday; 13 Nov is the Friday.
- La Nación print edition 14 Nov 2026, headline 'El Banco Central hizo la liberación de fondos de los CDA, desde ayer' (search result only; page not opened).
- Criptoinforme: says CDA payments began 13 Nov 2026 per the BCP, with registration at registrocda.bcp.gov.py.
- laclave.com.py 12 Nov: says G. 1.79 trillion was transferred to banks for 29,988 CDA holders, held back until ownership is confirmed.
- Hoy 11 Nov (search result only): 'BCP libera fondos para titulares de CDA pero con bloqueo preventivo'.
- Hoy 17 Nov: the BCP says banks are continuing CDA payments over the following days; no start date in the text.
- El Nacional (search result only): checks on ownership and endorsements are keeping some CDA payments blocked.
- RDN 18 Nov: the BCP extended the deposit-guarantee payment period to 2 Dec 2026 (it originally ended 17 Nov).
- The question's background says no CDA payment date had been announced as of 13 Nov, which conflicts with the La Nación report.
- Resolves on a statement by the BCP, its Equipo Interventor or the FGD naming a calendar day, not on whether payments actually happen. The open issue is whether 'este viernes' counts as a specific calendar day.
- Event window: question creation to 28 Nov 2026 23:59 PYT; as of 18 Nov most of it has passed.
- Searched for but not found: a BCP press release on bcp.gov.py with an explicit CDA start date, and any human prediction market.

calls.reconciliation: No web access on this run. All three dossiers agree on the key fact: La Nación 13 Nov 2026 attributes to the BCP an announcement that ueno CDA fund releases begin 'this Friday' (13 Nov 2026 is a Friday; one fetched text saying 'Friday, November 15' is a misprint, since 15 Nov is a Sunday). La Nación print 14 Nov, Criptoinforme and Hoy 17 Nov corroborate. Nobody retrieved the BCP's primary text, so the claim rests on La Nación's attribution, which counts as directly quoted in a credible source. The remaining disputes are judgment calls: whether 'este viernes' is a specific calendar day (likely yes, given the article date), and whether the resolver will follow the background's claim that no date existed as of 13 Nov or the anticipo exclusion in the fine print, since the 13 Nov release may be the unblocking of anticipo funds credited 11 Nov. I cannot settle that last factual nuance from the dossiers. Some upside comes from a possible second-round dated announcement. I land at 0.85 because those interpretive risks are real.
